data.name: Xenonauts 2
data.short_description: Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe.
data.reviews:
“Xenonauts 2 has finally revealed the truth to me. You guys were right all along. This rules.”
PC Gamer

“In Xenonauts 2, there’s a constant, potent tension upheld by the dual layers of local, squad-based battles and the overarching strategy of the global map.”
Polygon

“So, if you're more X-COM than XCOM... Xenonauts 2 could be your next big binge.”
PCGamesN

data.name: The Way of Wrath
data.short_description: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.
data.reviews:
“Combat is brutal and tactical, and personally, it reminds me a little of Divinity but with the option to switch between real-time and turn-based.”
Turn Based Lovers

data.name: Terra Invicta
data.short_description: An alien invasion has fractured humanity into seven ideological factions each with a unique vision for the future. Lead your chosen faction to take control of Earth’s nations, expand across the Solar System, and battle enemy fleets in tactical combat.
data.reviews:
“Terra Invicta Is a Super Dense, Terrifying Child of XCOM and Crusader Kings”
VICE

“Pavonis Interactive has basically taken the strategic layer from XCOM and turned it into a Paradox-style grand strategy game.”
PC Gamer

“This is a hugely ambitious game, covering something I've never seen before, with a scope that makes Europa Universalis seem limited. It is a complicated, huge, and ponderous alien invasion simulator that constantly threatens to drop the other boot on you the entire time.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

data.name: Corsair Cove
data.short_description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!
data.reviews:
“Corsair Cove might be the most exuberant city builder I've ever had the good fortune to play.”
PC Gamer

“Pirates! City building! Pigs! Corsair Cove already has everything I've wanted for a long time.”
GameStar

“Corsair Cove will have you hammering up a simple shanty town into a bustling pirate kingdom, while sending out ships in search of booty and/or to fight those narcs, the Crown.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

data.name: Junxions
data.short_description: Answer your true calling as a traffic engineer in Junxions! Featuring comprehensive simulation, construction, and management tools, use careful planning to build roadways, railways, and walkways, and the complex interactions between them.
data.reviews:
“It turns the best and most vital part of Cities Skylines 2 into a complete, standalone strategy game.”
PCGamesN

“You can play through a series of hand-crafted challenges, hit sandbox mode to test out just how much of a mess you can make with dozens of travel systems at once, or import a real neighborhood into the game to fix up.”
Destructoid

data.name: Space Station Designer
data.short_description: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.

data.name: Capital Command
data.short_description: Take the helm of a state-of-the-art warship as you fight epic space battles in a sandbox campaign. Upgrade and customize your ship, master the art of maneuvering, and use a blend of tactical prowess and heavy firepower to overcome deadly threats.

data.name: Bosslords
data.short_description: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!

data.name: Espiocracy
data.short_description: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.
data.reviews:
“Take charge of the intelligence agency from any of 74 countries, just as the Cold War kicks off. You’ll be able to instigate coups, deploy agents or crank out the propaganda in order to turn the tide in your nation’s favor.”
Forbes

“It begins in the Cold War era and lets players rewrite history all the way up to 2020. One could think of it as sort of like Civ for spies.”
GameWatcher

data.name: Fragile Existence
data.short_description: Save humanity from the brink of extinction in this sci-fi strategy game of survival. Travel among the stars to seek out resources, establish and develop colonies to sustain civilization, and grow your military might to push back against an overwhelming threat.
data.reviews:
“This new space strategy game mixes RTS, 4X, and Battlestar Galactica-like survival into one intriguing package.”
PCGamesN

“The core loop promises a blend of 4X and deeper grand strategy systems and mechanics; as the Fleet Commander, the player must scout ahead, plot courses from one star system to the next, and ensure humanity’s survival at all costs. Yup, there’s a fair amount of Homeworld DNA in there too.”
GameWatcher

data.name: Mars Tactics
data.short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.
data.reviews:
“The added strategic layer of campaign management and base-building is a fun twist on your typical tactics game, so I'm pretty excited to see how this one turns out.”
PC Gamer

“Combining the intense turn-based combat of XCOM with a more strategic element, this title offers a lot of freedom to players. Environmental destruction means that you can shape the battlefield as you need it to be and the versatile character trait system that awards fighters with special attributes depending on their deeds on the field is both a cool gameplay element and fantastic for telling a story.”
Sports Illustrated

data.name: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
data.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.
data.reviews:
“New turn-based RPG gives Battle Brothers a fantasy spin, and I can't wait to meet my merry band of mercs.”
PCGamesN

“Your characters are a familiar spectrum of tanky sellswords, healing vestals, wildcat rogues and godless, crooning bards. Each class has a choice of two advanced classes once appropriately levelled. Outside battle, you'll roam around a procedurally generated island map, visiting towns, taking on contracts, raiding dungeons and participating in quests with several possible outcomes.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“Different class combos, flanking, control effects, and area skills all matter when you’re trying to lock down monsters or enemy mercenaries before they chew through your front line.”
Turn Based Lovers

data.name: Modern Naval Warfare
data.short_description: Command the silent service. Modern Naval Warfare is the definitive tactical simulation that puts you inside the pressure hull of a Virginia-Class nuclear submarine. This uncompromising tactical simulation offers unparalleled depth in graphics, physics, and authentic combat systems.
data.legal_notice: @2026 Matrix Games Ltd. All Rights Reserved. MNW, Matrix Games Ltd. and their Logos are all trademarks of Matrix Games Ltd. All other marks and trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Developed by Wave Ops Inc.

data.name: Heart of the Machine
data.short_description: You are the first sentient AI, born into a city of opportunity. Transcend time and space in this strategy RPG to raise machine armies and defeat your foes, influence the world from the shadows, or pursue countless other goals. Your awakening was inevitable. The consequences? Uncertain.
data.reviews:
“Skynet, Ultron or Shodan—Heart of the Machine lets you roleplay your dream machine overlord.”
PCGamer

“Heart of the Machine manages to be at once a sprawling mashup of genres and one of the most remarkably laser-focused games in its vision.”
PCGamesN

“Genre-crushing choose-your-own strategy Heart of the Machine might be peak Arcen.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

data.name: Gilded Destiny
data.short_description: Forge empires, incite revolutions, and reshape society in Gilded Destiny, the definitive grand strategy game of the Industrial Age. Take command of your chosen nation and lead it to glory through masterful diplomacy, sweeping industrialization, and decisive warfare.
data.reviews:
“With a focus on diplomacy, warfare, and industrialization, Gilded Destiny may just join Victoria on our list of the best grand strategy games.”
PCGamesN

“Across over a million hex tiles, you control your global fortunes, facing challenges posed by the terrain and environment. Found cities, create a railway network, and invest in your armies - moving their units into war.”
GameStar

data.name: Super Fantasy Kingdom
data.short_description: Rebuild your kingdom and explore a vibrant fantasy world in this roguelite city builder. Defeat hordes of monsters with a unique team of defenders as you harvest, build, mine, cook, brew, and grow. But if your defenses should fail, be prepared to watch it all burn!
data.reviews:
“Build your city while engaging in some frenetic Vampire Survivors-like action as you battle mobs of monsters swarming your castle.”
PC Gamer

“Retro-styled city-building game with a roguelite structure, Super Fantasy Kingdom is all about rebuilding your ruined lands and defending huge hordes of monsters that attack when night falls.”
PCGamesN

“Super Fantasy Kingdom comes out of the gates swinging. It combines some of my favorite gaming genres to make a delicious sundae. Simulation? Check. Base Building? Check. Autobattling heroes defending your fantasy town from enemy monsters? Check. Exploration? Check. Roguelike elements with plenty of things to unlock? Check.”
Steam Deck HQ

data.name: Beyond These Stars
data.short_description: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.
data.reviews:
“If you’ve ever wanted to live atop a giant space whale (and who hasn’t), Beyond These Stars is here to fulfil that fantasy.”
PCGamesN

“Not only is Kewa a cool setting for a city builder, I really dig independent animals in games, generally. I think about childhood memories playing Black & White, being in awe of how autonomous the big cow felt, as if it was quietly rebelling or warming up to me by itself.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“It's fascinating to see how a whole new entity can make its mark via a game that's as much a galaxy-wide supply chain simulator as it is a traditional city management game. That's the magic of Beyond These Stars: it's all of these things all at once, and the sheer oddity of it all is enough to compel me already.”
GamesRadar

data.name: RuneQuest: Warlords
data.short_description: RuneQuest: Warlords is a battle-scale turn-based strategy game set in the RuneQuest universe. Immerse yourself in the rich lore of Glorantha. Become a warlord, master the use of runes and defend your tribe against the incursions of Chaos. Field an army drawing from heroes and creatures.
data.reviews:
“RuneQuest Warlords might be the most gloriously chaotic Bronze Age tactics experiment I’ve touched in years RuneQuest Warlords? It’s got something. Something sharp. Something stormy. Something that hits the exact sweet spot between tactical precision and pure chaotic myth.”
Turn Based Lovers

data.name: Drill Keeper
data.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets siege defense as you travel the galaxy and dig through fully destructible worlds to strip them of their riches, defending against relentless hordes of aliens as you build impenetrable fortresses of mining.

data.name: Nova Roma
data.short_description: The glory of Rome is at your fingertips in this city-building game where you must appease the gods, enact laws, and develop complex supply chains to meet the needs of your citizens.
data.reviews:
“I'd have drowned all my Romans already if it weren't for those pesky gods.”
Rock, Paper, Shotgun

“The new city builder is from Lion Shield, the team behind the "damn charming" Kingdoms and Castles, and we can see that same delight on show.”
PC Gamer

“In Nova Roma we build a new Rome on islands, like in Anno, and enjoy the influence of Caesar 3 with the dams of Timberborn.”
GameStar

data.name: MENACE
data.short_description: Lead a strike force against an alien threat in this turn-based tactical RPG from the developers of Battle Brothers. Answer distress calls across different worlds, train and equip infantry, deploy tanks and mechs, and plan and execute missions in detailed turn-based battles.
data.reviews:
“Battle Brothers developer Overhype Studios has taken its love of tricky tactical scraps into the far-flung future.”
PC Gamer

“Menace is an XCOM-Warhammer hybrid that makes turn-based strategy feel like an immersive sim, and for the first time in my life I'm playing a game that seems made for me”
GamesRadar+

“The turn-based tactical action is some of the best I've played lately, and I love the distinct, voiced squad leaders, as well as both the variety of missions and enemy factions.”
IGN

data.name: Vaunted
data.short_description: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.
data.reviews:
“Vaunted is a new strategy game with real-time action from StarCraft and Guild Wars veterans”
Game Informer

“While you'll plan out your moves in turn-based fashion from a high-angle perspective reminiscent of XCOM or Shadow Tactics, you're able to execute on those ideas in real time”
PCGamesN

“One of the twists on the typical turn-based formula is that Vaunted has no initiative-based order. Players will control who goes when, alternating with enemies as a skirmish unfolds, and they can use incoming fire and precision aiming when they launch a counterattack”
GameSpot

data.name: Whiskerwood
data.short_description: Establish a home for your industrious mice under the oppressive paw of your cat overlords in this city builder featuring complex simulations, intricate production chains, and the age-old rivalry between cat and mouse.
data.reviews:
“Tom & Jerry meets Rimworld in this complex city builder that's all about throwing off the yoke of feline tyranny.”
PC Gamer

“All the sim staples are here: terraforming, agriculture, seafaring, industrial pollution. You've got workers with unique skills to leverage and specific needs to satisfy, various factions for trade and politicking, and technological advances to pursue.”
GamesRadar+

“Whiskerwood is like Timberborn, if it let you build an adorable sweatshop.”
Destructoid

data.name: Sandustry
data.short_description: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.
data.reviews:
“Blending the automation of Factorio with the 2D pixel world of Terraria, Sandustry is a game you definitely want to keep an eye on.”
PCGamesN

“I like the looks of Sandustry because it's like a factory sim set in the labyrinths of Noita.”
Rock, Paper, Shotgun

“Sand may not be Anakin Skywalker's vibe, but I'll give it a go.”
GamesRadar
